ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DLL Sideloading Of KeyScramblerIE.DLL Via KeyScrambler.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects potential DLL side loading of "KeyScramblerIE.dll" by "KeyScrambler.exe".
Various threat actors and malware have been found side loading a masqueraded "KeyScramblerIE.dll" through "KeyScrambler.exe".
 Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded, Signature, SignatureStatus

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\KeyScrambler\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\KeyScramblerLogon\\\.exe$")) AND ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\KeyScramblerIE\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\KeyScrambler\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\KeyScrambler\\\\.*")) AND (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\KeyScrambler\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\KeyScrambler\\\\.*"))) OR (Signature = "QFX\ Software\ Corporation" AND SignatureStatus = "Valid"))
